🌿 Daily Routine Guide

Your 12-Week Moringa Routine

A simple daily habit, built one step at a time.

  1. 1
    Week 1–2

    Getting Started

    Mix 5g (about 2 teaspoons) into lukewarm water, milk, buttermilk or a smoothie. Find the way you like it best.

  2. 2
    Week 3–4

    Make It a Habit

    Pick a fixed time each day, such as morning or lunch, so it becomes part of your routine.

  3. 3
    Week 6–8

    Try New Ways

    Stir it into dal, soup or salad, or mix it into roti dough or raita for some variety.

  4. 4
    Week 10–12

    Part of Your Day

    By now it fits naturally into your day. Plan your next pack in time so you do not run out.

At 5g a day, a 100g pack lasts about 20 days, a 200g pack about 40 days, a 250g pack about 50 days and a 500g pack about 100 days.

This is a usage guide, not a promise of results. Natural food product, not a medicine.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is TODAYS AYURVEDA Moringa Leaf Powder?+

A single-ingredient powder made from shade-dried Moringa oleifera leaves, finely milled to 80 mesh. It has no added preservatives, sugar or artificial colours.

How do I use it?+

A common serving is about 2 teaspoons (around 5g) a day. Mix it into water, a smoothie, curd, buttermilk or atta dough. Start small and see how it suits you.

Which pack size should I choose?+

100g gives about 20 servings, 200g about 40 servings, 250g about 50 servings and 500g about 100 servings at 5g per serve. Larger packs cost less per serving.

Is it FSSAI registered and lab tested?+

Yes. Our FSSAI registration number is 21426470002269 and the lab report number is QAL/MT/260818005486. Tap the Lab Tested and FSSAI Registered badges in the page footer to view both documents.

How do I place an order and pay?+

Fill in the order form on this page and you will be taken to a secure Razorpay payment page (UPI, Card or Netbanking) with the exact amount of your pack already fixed. Your order is confirmed right after payment, with no confirmation call.

Is delivery free, and how long does it take?+

Delivery is free on all orders. Enter your pincode in the order form and we will check your area. Your order confirmation appears on screen right after payment.

How should I store it?+

Keep it in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight, and reseal the pouch tightly after every use.

Is it safe during pregnancy or with medication?+

This is a food product, not a medicine. If you are pregnant, nursing, on medication or have a health condition, please check with your doctor before adding it to your diet.

Shri Radha Krishna

Pure love • Devotion • Harmony with nature

Radha and Krishna are loved across India as the symbol of pure, selfless love and devotion. Their story is set in Vrindavan, a land of green forests, the river Yamuna, cows and fresh butter, where life is lived close to nature.

Krishna's peacock feather and flute stand for joy and harmony, while Radha stands for devotion and gentle compassion. Together they remind us that real love is simple, honest and pure.

At TODAYS AYURVEDA, we try to carry the same spirit of purity and care into everything we make, from carefully selected leaves to your home.

श्री राधा और कृष्ण पूरे भारत में पवित्र, निस्वार्थ प्रेम और भक्ति के प्रतीक माने जाते हैं। उनकी कथा वृंदावन की है, जहाँ हरे-भरे वन, यमुना नदी, गायें और ताज़ा माखन हैं और जीवन प्रकृति के बहुत करीब है।

कृष्ण का मोरपंख और बाँसुरी आनंद और सद्भाव का प्रतीक हैं, और राधा भक्ति व कोमल करुणा की। दोनों हमें याद दिलाते हैं कि सच्चा प्रेम सरल, ईमानदार और पवित्र होता है।

TODAYS AYURVEDA में हम भी यही पवित्रता और देखभाल अपने हर उत्पाद में रखने की कोशिश करते हैं, चुनी हुई पत्तियों से आपके घर तक।

Small Batches, Trusted Quality

Small batches • Leaves only • Your trust matters

Why small batches? We prefer to pack our Moringa Leaf Powder in small, carefully handled batches so that what reaches you is fresh. Availability can vary from batch to batch.

Leaves only. Moringa stems and twigs make the powder coarse and woody, so the powder is made from dried moringa leaves only. The result is a fine green powder that mixes smoothly.

Built on trust. Batch DE-MOR-004 has been tested at QA Testing Laboratories, Lucknow (Report No. QAL/MT/260818005486), our business is FSSAI registered (21426470002269), and we keep it simple: single ingredient, no preservatives, no added sugar, no artificial colours.

छोटे बैच क्यों? हम अपना मोरिंगा लीफ पाउडर छोटे-छोटे बैच में, पूरी देखभाल के साथ पैक करना पसंद करते हैं ताकि आप तक ताज़ा माल पहुँचे। अलग-अलग बैच में उपलब्धता अलग हो सकती है।

सिर्फ़ पत्तियाँ। मोरिंगा की डंडियाँ और लकड़ी पाउडर को मोटा और खुरदुरा बना देती हैं, इसलिए पाउडर सिर्फ़ सूखी मोरिंगा पत्तियों से बनता है। नतीजा: बारीक हरा पाउडर जो आसानी से घुल जाता है।

भरोसे पर टिका ब्रांड। बैच DE-MOR-004 की जाँच QA Testing Laboratories, लखनऊ में हुई है (रिपोर्ट नं. QAL/MT/260818005486), हमारा व्यवसाय FSSAI रजिस्टर्ड है (21426470002269), और हम चीज़ें सीधी रखते हैं: एक ही सामग्री, कोई प्रिज़र्वेटिव, अतिरिक्त चीनी या कृत्रिम रंग नहीं।

Complete Product Information

About TODAYS AYURVEDA Moringa Leaf Powder

TODAYS AYURVEDA 100% Natural Moringa Leaf Powder is made from carefully selected, shade-dried Moringa leaves (Moringa oleifera) to preserve natural nutrients, vibrant green color, and freshness. Tested for heavy metals and microbiological parameters, it is a clean, plant-based ingredient for daily nutrition.

Key Product Highlights
  • • 100% Pure & Natural: Single-ingredient Moringa oleifera leaf powder with zero preservatives, artificial colors, flavors, or added sugar.
  • • Nutritional Profile (Approx., Per 100g): 25.01g Protein, 18.69g Dietary Fibre, 362.82 kcal Energy, and 1869.62 mg Calcium.
  • • Lab Tested & FSSAI Registered: Tested under Report No. QAL/MT/260818005486 for heavy metals and microbiological safety.
  • • 100% Vegan: Clean plant-based food suitable for daily family nutrition.

Nutrition values are approximate and come from the business-provided Nutritional Information Chart. The lab report covers heavy metals, microbiological and basic physical parameters only.

How to Use (5g Daily Serving Guide)
  • • Recommended Serving: 5g (approx. 2 teaspoons) once daily.
  • • Servings Per Pack: 100g = ~20 Servings | 200g = ~40 Servings | 250g = ~50 Servings | 500g = ~100 Servings.
  • • Preparation Method: Mix about 2 teaspoons (5g) into lukewarm water, milk, smoothie, buttermilk, or fresh juice, or stir into soups, salads, and dal.
  • • Storage Advice: Store in a cool, dry place away from direct sunlight and reseal the pouch tightly after each use.
